title: GoCell Assembly Descriptor
description: Defines an Assembly, the physical packaging unit. K#10: minimal required = id+cells+owner; build fields are derived from cell.yaml type when omitted.

id.description: Unique assembly identifier. Must equal the directory name under assemblies/. 2-32 chars (composed-name budget for healthz probe).

cells.description: List of cell ids included in this assembly.

build.description: Build configuration for the assembly. All fields optional; defaults are derived.

deployTemplate.description: Deployment template identifier. Omit to use the parser-applied default "k8s" (the JSON Schema `default` keyword is documentation only — actual defaulting happens in metadata.applyAssemblyDerivations).

compositionAPI.description: When true, GenerateModulesGen emits the runtime/composition.CellModule form (cellmodules/{cell}.Module() constructors) instead of the legacy local-CellModule-type form. Set true only in cellmodules-based assemblies (currently assemblies/corebundle).
